r: kswitch makes the specified credential cache the primary cache for the collection, if a cache collection is available.

-c cachename
Directly specifies the credential cache to be made primary.
-p principal
Causes the cache collection to be searched for a cache containing credentials for principal. If one is found, that collection is made primary.
See kerberos(7) for a description of Kerberos environment variables.

FILE:/tmp/krb5cc_%{uid}
Default location of Kerberos 5 credentials cache
